purpose: Extend Scan 013 empirically: test whether verifiability transformation also governs non-financial exchanges involving used equipment, human skill, supplier capability, product quality and digital/embedded rights. This is scan number 014 and is not Formation 014.

evidence: XCMG's used-equipment platform has evolved into an end-to-end system covering equipment assessment, transaction, finance and logistics, and is building standardized datasets from transaction and equipment-operation data.

XCMG's training material explicitly identifies inconsistent appraisal standards, shortage of professional appraisers and incomplete valuation systems as factors that reduce used-equipment circulation efficiency and value.
Certified used-equipment auctions combine inspection/certification and remanufacturing standards with transaction channels; public XCMG material reports large-scale historical transaction volumes.
findings.interpretation: A used machine's physical existence is insufficient for efficient exchange; condition, history and value must become legible and credible to the buyer. Generic used-equipment appraisal/marketplace is already organized in this ecosystem.

evidence: Xuzhou is expanding enterprise-led skill evaluation under the principle 'who uses, evaluates, certifies and takes responsibility', with practical ability, technical problem-solving and job performance used as core evidence rather than only education or seniority.
In the first four months of 2026 Xuzhou reported 11,611 newly certified high-skill workers and 1,535 new technician-or-above qualifications.
findings.interpretation: Human capability also needs a representation the receiving organization trusts. Generic skill-certification infrastructure is not a missing edge; useful residue would be high-value abilities that remain poorly represented by certificates, CVs or formal grades and are still judged through trial work, references, portfolios or prolonged observation.

evidence: XCMG quality-management material describes supplier-entry and quality-control penetration through integrated systems and traceability rather than relying on supplier claims alone.

A recent supply-chain matching event with XCMG required participating manufacturers to present products/technical plans while buyer-side teams discussed supply capability, quality control and cooperation models; some reached preliminary cooperation intent.
findings.interpretation: Supplier capacity is not transactionally real merely because machinery or claimed capability exists; the buyer needs product, process, quality and delivery evidence expressed in its procurement coordinate system. This reinforces BOUNDARY_TRANSLATION plus VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION.

evidence: Five Xuzhou agricultural products entered the 2026 national distinctive/high-quality agricultural product list after multi-level review and may use the official mark in sales.
The system uses standardized production, quality evidence, certification/branding and increasingly traceability to turn otherwise hard-to-observe product quality into a market-recognizable signal.
findings.interpretation: Quality may exist before certification, but downstream buyers/consumers cannot fully observe it. Trusted marks and traceability reduce that verification gap. Generic agricultural certification/branding is not whitespace.

evidence: A Xuzhou court-explainer case describes a used new-energy vehicle whose physical ownership transfer was completed, but the buyer could not transfer the vehicle app/account because an outstanding loan/mortgage restriction remained.

The vehicle faced remote-lock risk and core digital-control functions were impaired; the legal explanation states that transfer of physical title alone did not complete the seller's obligations because account/intelligent-control rights are core to use.
findings.mechanism: PHYSICAL_ASSET_TRANSFER + HIDDEN ATTACHED LIEN/DIGITAL CONTROL/ACCOUNT STATE -> APPARENT EXCHANGE BUT INCOMPLETE USABLE RIGHTS
findings.search_rule: For connected/digital assets, model the transferable object as a rights/control bundle, not a single ownership field. Inspect debt, account binding, software entitlement, remote-control authority, warranty/service rights, licenses and data access when material.

evidence: Engineering-machinery quality systems, second-hand machine datasets, agricultural quality marks and enterprise skill evaluation all make otherwise hidden state observable through different forms of evidence and accountability.
The used-EV dispute shows the inverse case: an apparently completed transaction can fail when material state/right fields remain hidden.
findings.interpretation: VERIFIABILITY_TRANSFORMATION is therefore not limited to finance. It applies whenever exchange depends on a counterparty accepting claims about condition, capability, quality, rights or control.

evidence: A June 2026 Xuzhou report on industry-linked talent training states that enterprises can recruit graduates who interview well but cannot immediately perform on the shop floor; the report says some require three to five months of training before they can work effectively.

The local response is already moving toward enterprise orders, school-industry training, practical skill evaluation, internships and production-line learning, so the generic training/credential route is not absent.
findings.interpretation: This is direct evidence that existing credentials/interviews can leave a capability-proof gap with measurable onboarding cost. It does not prove demand for a new verification platform. The useful residual is the subset of roles where substantial re-verification/retraining remains after current enterprise-led training and skill-evaluation mechanisms.
findings.next_truth: Find named role/task classes where employers still incur repeated trial-work, retraining, supervision or failure cost after using current credentials/training routes, and identify what task-level proof would materially reduce that cost.

search_rules_refined.name: STATE_LEGIBILITY_CHECK
questions: What material state does the counterparty need to believe before acting?
Who verifies or is accountable for it?
Is the evidence current and decision-relevant rather than decorative?
Does making the state legible measurably change willingness to transact?

search_rules_refined.name: RIGHTS_BUNDLE_COMPLETENESS
questions: What rights and control channels travel with the asset beyond physical title?
Are there liens, account bindings, software entitlements, remote-control rights, licenses, warranties, data access or service dependencies?
Can any retained third-party right materially prevent normal use after transfer?

search_rules_refined.name: CAPABILITY_PROOF_RESIDUE
questions: Which valuable supplier/human capabilities remain difficult to prove through existing certification, CV, portfolio or quality systems?
What workaround does the buyer currently use: trial order, trial work, reference, on-site audit, sample, warranty, escrow or prolonged observation?
What is the measurable cost of that workaround?
